files.notes/thresholds.md:
# Slow-query alerting sheet (effective 2026-09-01)

- reporting-class dbs (reporting, analytics): dur > 3 s counts as slow
- etl-class dbs (etl_warehouse): dur > 8 s counts as slow
- alert: a reporting-class db logging more than 5 slow queries in any
  10-minute window pages on-call
